notes: Print font: CMU Serif (OFL confirmed, see openQuestions). print: false added: none; the PLAN §1 trims already in WP-03's content fit with about 0.2 in to spare at build date 2026-10-15 (out of 10 in). LaTeX: local tectonic blocked by the proxy (bundle host 403); rely on the CI latex job. Preview PNGs for R0 to send Emeka (never commit; out/ is gitignored): out/review/resume-before.png and out/review/resume-after.png (150 dpi), out/before/resume-1.png and out/after/resume-1.png (110 dpi), out/resume-preview.png. The before images are rendered from the original PDF and show the phone number, so they must not be attached to a PR or copied into the repo. Change log: docs/RESUME_CHANGES.md. Design notes: the overflow gate measures .pr-page in print media after document.fonts.ready and fails if CMU Serif did not load; hyphenated and slashed words are kept on one line (white-space: nowrap) so extraction never reads 'end-to- end'; bullet markers are in normal flow because a positioned box paints in a later layer and moved every bullet to the end of pdf.js's text order (a pitfall worth knowing for any print view). The PDF carries Title, Author, Subject 'Resume', comma-separated Keywords from the skills, Creator 'Commit History build', Producer 'Playwright + pdf-lib', dates from the build date, DisplayDocTitle, Lang en-CA from the page, and a document ID hashed from the content, so dist/resume.pdf is byte-identical between runs. Process: committed straight onto the integration branch like WP-02 and WP-03; nothing pushed. npm ci was not run because node_modules is installed and a parallel worktree is active; npm ls --depth=0 shows no invalid or missing entries. npm run verify green (214 unit tests); npm run build green (the client chunk hash is unchanged, main-DlepCaGS.js). The commit order puts the .tex generator before the PDF build because the private build imports renderResumeTex.
